title: Artifact: ML-KEM, NTRU, HQC, and Classic McEliece from CPU to TLS and QUIC: harnesses, raw measurement data, and packet traces
description: Version 2 (in v2/): parity-controlled measurement harnesses, liboqs build patches, raw per-trial data, packet traces, and analysis code for the paper "ML-KEM, NTRU, HQC, and Classic McEliece from CPU to TLS and QUIC: A Parity-Controlled Measurement Study and Selection Framework" (A. Sohail, 2026). Includes one CPU and RAPL energy harness for all four KEM families and the official HQC code at a fixed clock, a size-matched TCP transport emulation under latency, loss, and congestion, TLS 1.3 and QUIC handshake campaigns (OpenSSL 3.5, oqs-provider 0.12.0) with certificate chains, Retry, and a provider-path control, three inter-network paths, a cross-platform replication on AMD EPYC (Zen 4) and Google Axion (Arm) cloud machines, the constraint-first TOPSIS framework with its robustness analyses (including correlation-aware CRITIC weights), and robustness checks of the equivalence tests (visit-level bootstrap and margin sensitivity). Version 2.2.0 also makes the analysis pipeline portable; a clean-room rerun of v2.1.0 from this record regenerated every analysis output byte-identical. Version 1's files remain at the repository root. Code is MIT-licensed; measurement data is CC BY 4.0.
